The box has visible text 'PS4' and 'STAR WARS' (likely a bundle/edition).
No console body, no power cable, no HDMI cable, no storage/drive shown clearly.
A black cable is visible, but it’s unclear what it connects to (no ports/console shown).
No visible model label 'Pro' on the console or box in this photo.

risks.risk: It may not be a PS4 Pro (could be a standard PS4 or a different bundle).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model label/serial sticker (back/bottom) showing 'CUH-7xxx' (Pro) or equivalent, or a clear 'PS4 Pro' text on the box.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard PS4 bundle (worst case vs Pro).

risks.risk: Console may be missing parts or not complete (no clear view of console, HDMI, power supply, controller charging cable, etc.).
risks.proof: Photos showing the actual console unit with all included accessories laid out (power cable, HDMI, controller(s), headset/other items if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown working status bundle.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have drift/defects.
risks.proof: Video clip of both controllers connected to the console showing button presses and analog stick movement with no drift.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controllers may need repair/replacement (worst case).

risks.risk: Console may have storage issues, overheating, or be banned/locked (account/online restrictions).
risks.proof: Photo/video of system settings showing storage health (if available), firmware, and a quick boot into the home screen; also show PSN status if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified/possible faults.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console itself (front/back) and the model label/serial sticker showing whether it is PS4 Pro.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (power cable, HDMI, controllers, any other items).
Short video: power on + home screen + controller inputs working (both controllers).
Photo of system settings showing storage capacity and firmware (or a boot screen).
response.reason: The photo shows controllers and a PS4 box, but it does not clearly confirm 'PS4 Pro' or the console’s condition/contents. Without the model confirmation and working proof, a safe worst-case price cannot be set.
